name: Chep
tagline: Finds the lowest all-in US price for a product, shipping and coupons counted
description: Name a product, paste a SKU or send a link and it shops around for the cheapest total you would actually pay in the US, coupons and delivery included. Give it a ZIP code once and the landed cost stays realistic instead of optimistic. Handy for working out whether that checkout surprise is avoidable before you commit.
author: MortMatters
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
